# EmbersFort
> Agent-crawl entry points for the reconstructed EmbersFort repository.

- Start: AGENT_START_HERE.md
- Human/semantic map: MAP.md
- Exhaustive file index: CRAWL_INDEX.md
- Machine graph: crawl-manifest.json
- Web crawl root (when Pages is enabled): docs/index.html

Preferred traversal: read a room, then follow its `## Thresholds` relative links. Use the exhaustive index only when you need discovery outside the semantic graph.
